server.call.argumentConversionFailed: The arguments do not match the tool''s input schema.
server.sessionBoard.notRecorded: The session board line was not recorded.
server.sessionBoard.livenessUnavailable: Session liveness is unavailable, so the session board cannot list running sessions.
server.classification.inputMismatch: Skill classification input does not match its contract.
server.classification.requestRejected: Skill classification request was rejected; no selection was accepted.
server.inventory.skillIdsRejected: The skillIds of get_skill_inventory were refused: each must be the id of an installed skill, and at most {limit} may be read in one call. details.skillIds lists the ids that are not installed.
server.classification.runtimeUnavailable: Skill classification configuration or runtime is unavailable; no selection was accepted.
server.classification.capacityExceeded: Skill classification reached its capacity; no selection was accepted.
server.classification.cancelled: Skill classification was cancelled; no selection was accepted.
server.classification.failed: Skill classification failed; no selection was accepted.
server.updates.argumentsInvalid: check_for_updates accepts only an optional boolean force field.
server.sessionMessage.sendInvalid: {cause} Use prepare_session_message for a new intent, then send only its returned messageId. For an uncertain prior send, retry that known ID or compare saved receipts/status.
server.workflowChange.stage: [Sennard workflow change] Next stage: {stageId} (capability {capability}); record its result under the {provider} provider contract.
server.workflowChange.planning: Run {runId} started in its planning phase, because start_workflow was given no changePlan: read and investigate only. Edits inside its writeTargets are refused until you call submit_change_plan with runId {runId}, expectedRevision {revision}, files (what you will change, all inside writeTargets) and a new operationKey. A start_workflow call that gives changePlan starts the run executing at once.
server.workflowChange.skills: The workflow changed: before the next judgment or action, re-match it against the skill targets and call every match now. A stage''s provider is only the contract its result is recorded under; it does not limit the skills used, and another skill needs no plan change.
server.workflowChange.verification: Before first running a test, install or external tool in an environment, read that environment''s guide and the script of its last successful run and set every condition the run needs at once. Before a full verification of a change to something many places read (fixed values, hashes, contracts, formats, public text), find its readers first and fix them in one pass. If failures keep changing under the same change, stop fixing one at a time and regroup the causes. Read every verification runner''s result before reporting.
server.promptRecap.sharedContextHint: If this turn produced a decision or a user correction that later sessions need, save it now with checkpoint_context (this session) or checkpoint_role_context (this role).
server.promptTranscript.unsupported: This server does not read the transcripts of the host {host} yet.
server.promptTranscript.unreadable.notAT: The file is not in the transcript format of the host.
server.promptTranscript.unreadable.entry: The entry that was located is no longer in the transcript.
server.promptTranscript.unreadable.fileM: The transcript file does not exist.
server.promptTranscript.unreadable.fileD: The transcript file may not be read.
server.promptTranscript.unreadable.fileI: The transcript file cannot be read.
server.promptTranscript.unreadable.noneN: The host named no transcript for this prompt.
server.promptTranscript.unreadable.pathN: The transcript path stored for this prompt is not a path on this computer.
server.workflowChange.classification: Skill advice is configured: JEV classifies each user request by itself and a hook gives its advice as context. Adopt, correct or reject the advice and make the final selection yourself; with no advice, choose yourself and continue.
server.changeJournal.unplanned: [Sennard change journal] {count,number} file(s) changed outside the submitted change plan: {paths}. If they belong to this work, add them with submit_change_plan; if not, undo them.
server.changeJournal.unplannedMore: [Sennard change journal] {more,number} more files outside the plan are not listed.
server.changeJournal.unreadable: [Sennard change journal] These paths could not be read, so whether they changed is unknown: {paths}.
server.changeJournal.clean: [Sennard change journal] No change outside the submitted change plan (planned files changed: {changed,number}, not changed: {unchanged,number}).
server.changeJournal.unavailable: [Sennard change journal] The change journal could not be read ({cause}), so changes outside the plan are not reported for this call.
